title: The gap between two panels
intro: On an assembly line, the gap between two body panels is normal with mean μ = 2.0 mm and standard deviation σ = 0.25 mm. The specification is 1.8 to 2.2 mm. The density at 1.8 mm is 1.16 per mm, more than 1, because σ is small; it is a height, not a probability. The shaded area, the share of gaps in specification, is Φ(0.8) − Φ(−0.8) = 0.5763.
